name: Universal Roblox Theme Park
desc:
Welcome to the largest theme park on Roblox. There's tons to do at our park, such as:
- 🎢 Ride thrilling rollercoasters and unbelievable dark rides
- ☀️ Journey through incredible themed-lands
- 🔘 Help operate the park with cashier, custodian, and mechanic jobs
- ➕ Meet people, roleplay, and make unforgettable memories with friends
It's all here waiting for you here at Universal Roblox!

👍 Leave a like to support the game! We really appreciate it 👍

Want to experience the park with your party only? Private servers are available! Please note, private servers will fill queues with bots to match the wait times in the public servers.

This game is not intended to be associated with any real-world companies. No copyright is intended. Generative AI is not used in this project.
